key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target. One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED libraries

-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 calls target_link_libraries on MODULE_LIBRARY targets (plugin .so files). CMake does not allow MODULE_LIBRARY targets to be linked as dependencies into other targets. This is triggered by ov_generate_plugins_hpp via ov_target_link_plugins. This is a pre-existing infrastructure/CMake issue unrelated to the PR's GPU kernel changes — it has been recurring since 2026-08-08 across 16 different PRs.
reproduction_steps: N/A - this is a CI infrastructure issue in the Android build configuration
recommended_actions: Fix cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 to not use target_link_libraries on MODULE_LIBRARY targets
The ov_target_link_plugins / ov_generate_plugins_hpp call chain needs to be reworked to avoid linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets directly
This appears to be a pre-existing infrastructure issue - investigate whether a recent CMake version change or plugin CMake type change caused this regression
prevention_strategies: Review CMake policy for plugin target types. MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked; consider using SHARED or interface-only dependencies for plugin discovery.
historical_context: This exact failure has been occurring since 2026-08-08 and has been recorded 16 times. It blocks the Android workflow for all PRs touching master branch.
